name: Pigeon Pose
instructions: From hands and knees, bring one knee forward and place your shin across your body, then extend the other leg straight back.
Sit your hips toward the floor and keep your torso upright.
Hold the stretch, then fold forward over your front leg for a deeper stretch if comfortable.
Repeat on the other side. Place a pillow under the hip if it does not reach the floor.
image_prompt_scene: In pigeon pose with the front shin angled, the back leg extended and the torso upright.
